title: Hanz needs an alibi

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: What? What is it? What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? What is it? What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Me? Ha! No, no. Never better. Never never better. Why, what have you heard? Has someone been talking?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? Ha! No, no. Never better. Never never better. Why, what have you heard? Has someone been talking?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Just gossip, yes, gossip is what it is. Rumors. Unfounded canards!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just gossip, yes, gossip is what it is. Rumors. Unfounded canards!

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Alright, I admit it, I need help. There was a slight incident last night at the hotel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, I admit it, I need help. There was a slight incident last night at the hotel.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: One of my guests, Ms Minty Chrome-Valience, very esteemed family, rolling in Lims, threw a party and one of the guests became rather... decompositionally dispositioned.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One of my guests, Ms Minty Chrome-Valience, very esteemed family, rolling in Lims, threw a party and one of the guests became rather... decompositionally dispositioned.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Oh, that's such a strong word. Especially when I have no doubt that their, um, departure was entirely the result of their own indulgence.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, that's such a strong word. Especially when I have no doubt that their, um, departure was entirely the result of their own indulgence.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: POV parties and pauper cruises are one thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: POV parties and pauper cruises are one thing.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: You don’t get it do you? My hotel is the lifeblood of this place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don’t get it do you? My hotel is the lifeblood of this place.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Much as I appreciate your enthusiasm, I already took care of that. We don’t have a Carbonizer 4000 Furnace in the basement for nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Much as I appreciate your enthusiasm, I already took care of that. We don’t have a Carbonizer 4000 Furnace in the basement for nothing.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: You’re making a mistake. And if I hear that you have breathed a word of this to anyone, it will be a fatal one. Understand?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re making a mistake. And if I hear that you have breathed a word of this to anyone, it will be a fatal one. Understand?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: All I need from you are a few words in the right ear to ensure my client and my hotel remains… unconnected to this distasteful business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All I need from you are a few words in the right ear to ensure my client and my hotel remains… unconnected to this distasteful business.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: That nuisance of a snoop Dotson is sniffing around. If you see him, simply tell him something like...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That nuisance of a snoop Dotson is sniffing around. If you see him, simply tell him something like...

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Say, 100 Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Say, 100 Lims?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Alright! Alright. There is something I’ve been saving. A Level 3 business license.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright! Alright. There is something I’ve been saving. A Level 3 business license.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: The license will be yours as soon as I hear the investigation has been concluded.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The license will be yours as soon as I hear the investigation has been concluded.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Who are you to judge that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are you to judge that?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: But if guests *actually* start dying in my hotel I can kiss the whole Aseptic-Max package goodbye. I'll be ruined!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But if guests *actually* start dying in my hotel I can kiss the whole Aseptic-Max package goodbye. I'll be ruined!

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: All I need from you are a few choice words in the right ear.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All I need from you are a few choice words in the right ear.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Half of the clients at that seedy little shack you call a noodle bar are Pov tourists from MY hotel.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Half of the clients at that seedy little shack you call a noodle bar are Pov tourists from MY hotel.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: Without the Grundown Ritz, this entire district would cease to exist. If I go down, champ, you go down with me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Without the Grundown Ritz, this entire district would cease to exist. If I go down, champ, you go down with me.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: You and my client Ms Valience were enjoying a friendly tete-a-tete at the time of the incident, near the Docks, between 2.05 and 2.11am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You and my client Ms Valience were enjoying a friendly tete-a-tete at the time of the incident, near the Docks, between 2.05 and 2.11am.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: It was supposed to be my retirement plan, but if this doesn’t go away, I’ll be retiring to the bottom of the sewers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was supposed to be my retirement plan, but if this doesn’t go away, I’ll be retiring to the bottom of the sewers.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text: What?! You can't be serious you... you opportunist! What do you want then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?! You can't be serious you... you opportunist! What do you want then?

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text:
*annoyed mumbling*
Alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
*annoyed mumbling*
Alright.

nodes.speaker: Hanz Grundown
nodes.text:
*annoyed mumbling*
Alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
*annoyed mumbling*
Alright.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You seem even more stressed than usual.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You seem even more stressed than usual.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You seem even more stressed than usual.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You seem even more stressed than usual.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's always gossip...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's always gossip...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I haven't heard anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I haven't heard anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Unfounded...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfounded...?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Define "incident".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Define "incident".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean dead?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean dead?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then what's the problem?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then what's the problem?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Too bad for you, I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Too bad for you, I guess.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Too bad for you, I guess.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Too bad for you, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what do you want me to do, get rid of the body?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what do you want me to do, get rid of the body?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what do you want me to do, get rid of the body?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what do you want me to do, get rid of the body?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Screw you and your Pov tourists.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Screw you and your Pov tourists.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Screw you and your Pov tourists.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Screw you and your Pov tourists.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what do you want me to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what do you want me to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what do you want me to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what do you want me to do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You want me to give you someone an alibi?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want me to give you someone an alibi?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You want me to give you someone an alibi?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You want me to give you someone an alibi?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not risking my neck for some CEO.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not risking my neck for some CEO.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not risking my neck for some CEO.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not risking my neck for some CEO.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's in it for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's in it for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Say I report this to CorpSec.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Say I report this to CorpSec.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Say I report this to CorpSec.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Say I report this to CorpSec.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Deal. But don't expect me to cry for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Deal. But don't expect me to cry for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Deal. But don't expect me to cry for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Deal. But don't expect me to cry for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure you are right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure you are right.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You mean "positioned to decompose"?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You mean "positioned to decompose"?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why don't you just call CorpSec?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why don't you just call CorpSec?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why don't you just call CorpSec?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why don't you just call CorpSec?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Then what do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whoah! Give it a rest!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoah! Give it a rest!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ridiculous!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds more like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds more like it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not enough!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not enough!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Add 5000 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Add 5000 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell your marketing team to boost my restaurant popularity even further. I'm dealing with competition.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell your marketing team to boost my restaurant popularity even further. I'm dealing with competition.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Tell your marketing team to boost my restaurant popularity even further. I'm dealing with competition.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Tell your marketing team to boost my restaurant popularity even further. I'm dealing with competition.
